question: The Sangeet Natak Akademi gives fellowships to eminent artists. Gopika Varma received it for Mohiniyattam which is a dance form of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mohiniyattam__ is one of the classical dance forms in India.

 __
 
• Mohiniyattam is originated from the state of Kerala.
 
• Mohiniyattam derives its name from the word ‘Mohini’, a female avatar of Lord Vishnu
 
• It is performed by women in honor of the Hindu god Vishnu in his incarnation as the enchantress Mohini.
 
• Music for Mohiniyattam is provided by a Karnataka (South Indian) classical music ensemble.
 
• It follows two performance categories namely, ‘Nritta’ and ‘Nritya’ mentioned in ‘Natya Shastra’.
 
• Mohiniyattam was patronized by Travancore ruler Maharaja Swathi Thirunal.
 
• Vallathol Narayana Menon is the poet who revived Mohiniattam.
 
 
 
• The main exponents of Mohiniyattam are:
 
 
• Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma.
 
• Sunanda Nair.
 
• Gopika Varma.
 
• Pallavi Krishnan.
